items: In mein se well-defined problem ki characteristics (khoobiyan) kaunsi hai? (a) Gol mol goals aur gair wazeh requirements (b) Vague (gol mol) process aur inputs (c) Saaf goals, inputs, process aur outputs (d) Undefined (jo tay na ho) hal
Kaunsi complexity class un maslon ki hai jo deterministic algorithm se efficiently hal ho sakte hain? (a) NP (b) NP-hard (c) NP-complete (d) P

Unsolvable problems ke baare mein kya sach hai? (a) Woh polynomial time mein hal ho sakte hain. (b) Unhein koi algorithm hal nahi kar sakta. (c) Woh hamesha NP class mein hote hain. (d) Unhein hal karne mein exponential waqt lagta hai.
Computational complexity mein NP ka matlab kya hai? (a) Non-deterministic Polynomial time (b) Negative Polynomial time (c) Non-trivial Polynomial time (d) Numerical Polynomial time
Bare datasets ke liye in mein se kaunsa (sorting) algorithm zyada efficient hai? (a) Bubble Sort (b) Merge Sort (c) Selection Sort (d) Quick Sort

Dynamic Programming kis soorat mein khaas taur par faidemand hai? (a) Jab maslon mein overlapping subproblems na hon. (b) Jab masla local (us waqt ke) faislon ke sequence (lari) se hal ho sake. (c) Jab maslon mein overlapping subproblems aur optimal substructure hon. (d) Jab masla independent (aik doosre se alag) subproblems mein baanta ja sake.
Kaunsa algorithm list mein baar baar chal kar aur ghalat tarteeb wale saath wale elements swap kar ke data sort karta hai? (a) Selection Sort (b) Quick Sort (c) Bubble Sort (d) Merge Sort
Graph mein Depth-First Search (DFS) ki time complexity kya hai? (a) O(n log n) (b) O(V²) (c) O(V + E) (d) O(n)

Time complexity ki behtareen definition kaunsi hai? (a) Algorithm ko chalne ke liye zaroori memory. (b) Algorithm ke mukammal hone ka waqt, input size ke function ke taur par. (c) Input barhne par efficiency qaim rakhne ki ability. (d) Algorithm ki space ki zaroorat ki oopri had.
Kis algorithm ki time complexity O(n log n) hai? (a) Bubble Sort (b) Binary Search (c) Merge Sort (d) Insertion Sort

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal 5 mein “search algorithm” likha hai, magar charon options sorting algorithms hain; matlab sorting algorithm hai. Merge Sort aur Quick Sort (average case) dono O(n log n) hain; chapter (3.5.1) bare datasets ke liye Merge Sort ko efficient kehta hai.

items: Computational problem-solving mein well-defined aur ill-defined problems mein farq bataiye.
Generate and Test algorithm ke basic qadam bayan kijiye.
Computational complexity ke hawale se tractable aur intractable problems ko compare kijiye.
Greedy Algorithms ka basic khayal mukhtasar bayan kijiye.
Dynamic Programming istemal karne ke faidon par baat kijiye.
Graph traversal mein Breadth-First Search (BFS) ke faidon ka Depth-First Search (DFS) se comparison kijiye.
Algorithmic soch mein masle ko chhote hisson mein torne ki ahmiyat samjhaiye.
Algorithm ki performance parakhne ke aham factors bataiye.
Alag alag complexity classes (P, NP, NP-hard, NP-complete) aur masle ki mushkil samajhne mein un ki ahmiyat par baat kijiye.
Detail se samjhaiye ke Halting Problem unsolvable kyun hai aur computer science mein is ke implications (asar) kya hain.
Search problems ki characteristics par baat kijiye aur Linear Search aur Binary Search ki efficiency ko compare kijiye.
Optimization problems ki nature (kis qisam ka hai) par baat kijiye aur asal zindagi mein un ke istemal ki misalein dijiye.
N-Queens problem ke hawale se Backtracking technique samjhaiye. Bataiye ke algorithm hal ke liye alag alag configurations kaise dekhta hai.
Bubble Sort algorithm ka process aur time complexity samjhaiye. Apni pasand ke kisi aur sorting algorithm se efficiency ko compare kijiye.
Time complexity aur space complexity ke farq par baat kijiye. Yeh kisi khaas masle ke liye algorithm ke choice (chunna) par kaise asar dalte hain?
